subject: Taxes
title: The Broker Reporting Rule
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Broker Reporting Rule.

hook.text: Starting 2025, US crypto brokers must file 1099 forms for every user—just like stock brokerages.

buildup.text: The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act of 2021 expanded 'broker' to include crypto exchanges.

discovery.text: Brokers must report gross proceeds, cost basis, and gains/losses for every transaction.

twist.text: The definition of 'broker' was controversially broad—potentially including miners and wallet developers.

climax.text: 1099 reporting transforms crypto from self-reported to third-party verified.

quiz.question: When do US crypto brokers start filing 1099 forms?
